decision: V494's sealed development evidence is independently reconstructed and hostile-test verified. Preserve the unchanged checkpoint and contract guard and proceed to exactly two paired host-initialization replications plus CPU throughput, TTFT, and RSS certification.
phase2_external_blocker: 21000 blinded judgments from three independent human raters remain unavailable and are not waived.
claim_boundary: Verified initial development evidence only; two replications, CPU runtime, TTFT, RSS, final quality, minimum information, Phase 3, and superiority remain unproven.
